jobs.occupation: Expert Corporate Treasury (m/f/d) (Treasury-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

Support our dedicated global project execution teams in all financing related topics. Work closely with the Vice President Corporate Treasury and an inspiring team of Treasury colleagues located in Stuttgart, Singapore and the US as well as with colleagues on projects. The role focuses on cash disposition and short-term cash planning for the Exyte Group, while ensuring that short-term cash plans can be effectively translated into mid-term planning. The role also includes a variety of treasury related activities, e.g. efficient processing and reporting of all guarantee related issues, being responsible for our global electronic banking system, communication with our core banks and treasury back-office tasks.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Consolidating and analyzing short-term cash forecasts to ensure liquidity.
- Performing data analysis on cash flow patterns, liquidity drivers, and forecast accuracy.
- Ensuring data quality, consistency, and integrity across systems and tools.
- Driving automation and digitalization through data modeling and workflow optimization.
- Acting as deputy for key treasury operations by overseeing the TMS (Coupa) and global electronic banking system (TIS), coordinating guarantee processes with internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring smooth, compliant end‑to‑end back‑office workflows when serving as stand‑in.

Show your expertise

- Completed university degree in Business Administration (Finance, Accounting or Controlling), along with at least three years of hands-on data analytics experience in the finance/treasury function of a multinational company or in the banking sector.
- Excellent command of German and English, strong IT affinity, and advanced proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel.
- Proven experience with treasury systems (Coupa, TIS) as well as core data analytics tools (SQL, Excel, Power BI; Python/R beneficial).
- Strong analytical capabilities, including descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, regression analysis, variance analysis, and effective data storytelling.
- Robust data literacy, including assessing data quality, performing data cleaning and transformation, defining and interpreting KPIs, and understanding underlying business processes.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to create dashboards, translate analytical findings into insights, and develop actionable recommendations.
- Key personal attributes include strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, organizational strength, a hands-on mindset, and the ability to work independently.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Project Manager / Project Controller (f/m/d) for Germany (Vertriebscontroller/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Controller / Commercial Project Manager (f/m/d), you will be the financial lead for a portfolio of complex real estate construction projects within Siemens Energy. Acting as the trusted finance business partner to the Real Estate Project Management organization, you will oversee budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and investment approvals while ensuring full compliance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Working closely with colleagues from Accounting, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and Real Estate, you will provide transparent financial insights that support strategic decisions and drive successful project delivery.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the commercial execution of a dedicated portfolio of real estate construction projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cost recognition, and financial reporting
* Prepare robust investment approvals by developing business cases, profitability analyses, and discounted cash flow models for strategic construction initiatives
* Establish accurate financial project structures in SAP, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure alignment with approved project budgets and schedules
* Ensure timely month-end closing, accurate project accounting, and full compliance with IFRS and Local GAAP throughout the project lifecycle
* Present clear financial performance reports, highlight cost deviations, and provide actionable recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Finance, Real Estate, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to enable informed commercial decision-making and successful project execution

What You Bring

* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics; a master's degree or CPA qualification is an advantage
* Longstanding professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Project Finance, ideally within construction, infrastructure, or capital investment projects
* Strong understanding of Financial Planning & Analysis/Business Case Models in preparation of investment approvals (e.g. proof of profitability & discounted cash flow calculation
* Proven experience managing CAPEX projects, annual budgets, forecasting, free cash flow, depreciation, and financial reporting for complex project portfolios
* Solid knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP, with hands-on experience in PP&E (CAPEX) accounting and strong SAP expertise, ideally across PS, CO, and FI modules
* Business fluent English communication skills

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.This role is available in Manchester, Amsterdam, and Berlin.This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.The Installer Support team serves as an escalation point for our network of channel partners who distribute, install and service residential Tesla energy products. We strive to empower our channel partners to provide the best end-customer experience possible, and we are an endpoint for determining next steps and solutions for many situations.Installer Support Engineering Technicians offer real-time diagnostics and solutions for trained on-site technicians during installation and maintenance of Tesla’s residential solar, storage and home charging energy products. Strong candidates for this role will already have knowledge in the residential energy industry. Applicants should expect to become a subject matter expert (SME) with Tesla’s energy products with the ability to remotely access and troubleshoot equipment.This is an exciting, fast-paced and rewarding role, and a fantastic opportunity to dig deep into our innovative products while collaborating with some of the most talented people in the world!

What You’ll Do

- Provide top-tier support for live on-site or off-site technical issues regarding residential energy products via phone, chat, email or other channels
- Follow best practices in case handling, follow-up, and documenting interactions and work performed with great detail
- Become highly knowledgeable in the technical operation and complexities of Tesla’s energy products
- Understand and troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems and their supporting components
- Read and understand single-line diagrams as they pertain to PV and storage systems as well as load and meter component placement
- Review operational logs in proprietary and non-proprietary applications
- Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams
- Identify process and knowledge gaps and submit feedback that leads to better training and resources
- Become a subject matter expert (SME) in residential Tesla energy products.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Insurance Manager (f/m/d) Liability / Financial Lines (Versicherungsprüfer/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In close collaboration with your team, you will play a key role within the global insurance and risk management of Siemens Energy. Working closely with your team, brokers, and insurers, you will actively shape the placement of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs in the international insurance market, provide advisory support to business units on complex contracts, and manage challenging claims. Your daily responsibilities will integrate legal and insurance expertise, strategic business thinking, negotiation skills, and the ability to effectively communicate complex issues.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for the design, placement, implementation, and management of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs, including the development of insurance terms and coverage concepts, considering the needs and risk profile of our business units
* Advising and placing liability project insurance
* Primary contact for insurance-related questions regarding contract structures and active participation in contract negotiations worldwide
* Supporting business units in reporting and processing insurance claims, as well as analysing and evaluating insurance solutions. Independently handling complex claims, with a particular focus on operational, product, and environmental liability claims, and managing claims processes abroad
* First point of contact for senior management-related questions regarding insurance coverage for the board and management in accordance with German corporate law

What You Bring

* Several years of relevant professional experience in a comparable position or relevant industry experience, particularly in the placement of international insurance programs, contract commentary, and claims handling in international project business
* Fluent in German (C1/C2) and English (C1), both written and spoken. Additional language skills, such as Spanish, are desirable
* Analytical skills and a confident approach to complex issues, connecting legal, technical, and economic aspects into clear recommendations
* Confident in negotiations, high level of personal responsibility, structured working style, and enjoyment of proactive topic advancement
* Proficient in all common MS Office applications and generative AI, with an affinity for implementing digital processes

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
